pr_title: changefeedccl: mark changefeeds idle when no recent kv activity
pr_body:
Changefeeds run indefinitely, which poses a problem for serverless in
being able to shut down nodes when there isn't any activity going on.
This change makes it so that a changefeed that hasn't emitted any KVs in
the last `changefeed.idle_timeout` duration (default 10 minutes) will be
marked as Idle and be able to be shut down.  Any new activity will
result in the changefeed no longer being idle.

Fixes #74749

Release note: None

issue_context.title: changefeed: Mark job idle
issue_context.body:
Add infrastructure to keep track of the number of messages emitted by aggregators, and communicate
this information to the frontier processor.

The job may decide to mark itself idle (depends on #74747) when:
  * the number of emitted messages remains at 0 for some period of (configurable) time
  * It is not currently performing a backfill
  * It has just written a checkpoint record
  * The checkpoint includes PTS record (protect when idle)
  
Edit CRDB-8671

Epic CRDB-13936
